criteria.requirement: The four independent dimensions have one canonical field/representation, owner and scope.
SemVer 2.0.0 applies only to efsVersion and release.version.
Capability contract version remains opaque, non-empty and exact; no SemVer ordering is defined.
Implementation build identity remains external provenance and is not a core manifest field.
No cross-dimension comparisons; Factory release comparison is scoped to exact publisher/Factory identity.
SemVer build metadata does not affect precedence; equal-precedence exact release labels are never implicitly selected.
Release version and digest remain distinct; a different digest for an existing exact release version is a conflict.
The normative model and language-neutral vectors are linked into the repository catalogue and architecture decision index.
